topic: The Soviet Union was a force for good in the world
reason: Con consistently demonstrated superior logical discipline. Three decisive advantages: (1) Distinction between Munich appeasement and the Secret Protocol as active territorial predation was never rebutted. (2) Credentialed prisoner framing for Soviet women neutralized Pro's STEM argument. (3) Cancer/surgery analogy dismantled Pro's shock therapy deflection. Pro relied too heavily on whataboutism.
summary: Pro argued WWII sacrifice, Sputnik, literacy, life expectancy gains. Con exposed internal contradictions, mass atrocities, statistical cherry-picking. Con's tighter logical discipline proved decisive.
